content.short: NFT Evening, launched in 2021, is the biggest website for NFT news, offering breaking news, upcoming mints, and interviews with NFT artists and projects, plus developer guides.
content.description: Since its 2021 launch, NFT Evening has established itself as a focused news platform for the NFT space, delivering breaking headlines, in-depth coverage of upcoming mint events, and interviews with leading NFT artists and projects. For developers, the site provides guides designed to support their projects and navigate the evolving ecosystem. With roughly 1.2 million views per month, NFT Evening is recognized as a leading NFT-focused website.
